behaviour.title: Behaviour
behaviour.sub: What the lanes learned about how you work, from your own answers, in this project only. Nothing here leaves this machine.
behaviour.mode.off: Nothing is recorded and nothing is loaded. It costs zero tokens. Earlier answers are kept.
behaviour.mode.observe: Your answers are recorded, so this page fills. The lanes behave as before: no suggestion, no proposal.
behaviour.mode.propose: Your answers are recorded. An accepted habit marks your usual option, and a run shows one proposal at most. Nothing changes without your yes.
behaviour.off.title: ORC does not learn from your answers now, and this costs nothing.
behaviour.off.kept: {n} answers from an earlier period are kept.
behaviour.off.how: Use the Learning switch above, or run one of these commands:
behaviour.noProposal: No habit waits for your decision now.
behaviour.emptyHint: Run a lane. Each question it asks is recorded in its trace, and this page fills from those lines.
behaviour.tile.savedNote: answered for you by the ledger or config
behaviour.nextRunNote: what your habits do on the next run of each lane
behaviour.state.observed: not enough answers yet, or the rule does not pass
behaviour.state.proposed: the rule passed. The decision is yours
behaviour.state.applied: in use, with an undo on the card
behaviour.state.declined: you said not now. It can come back later
behaviour.state.neverAsk: you said never. It is still recorded
behaviour.state.stale: your answers changed, so the habit is paused
behaviour.state.shadowed: your config file sets this key, so the file wins
behaviour.state.never: ORC shows this and never proposes it
behaviour.class.apply: answers a config key at the learned rank. Your own config always wins
behaviour.class.suggest: puts your usual option first. The question is still asked
behaviour.class.never: shown only. A person makes this choice every time
behaviour.by.ledger: you said it earlier, in the ledger
behaviour.by.learned: a habit you accepted chose the recommendation
behaviour.act.acceptWhat: ORC uses this from the next run. Your config file still wins. You can undo it with Forget on the same card.
behaviour.act.declineWhat: The proposal can come back after 10 more answers and 14 days.
behaviour.act.neverWhat: ORC keeps recording your answers but does not propose this again. Ask me again brings it back.
behaviour.act.forgetWhat: The habit stops at once. Your config file or the shipped default answers again. Past answers stop counting.
behaviour.act.resetWhat: This clears your no. The answers are kept, and the proposal can appear again.
behaviour.act.manual: This has no button on purpose. A person types this command:
behaviour.confirmNote: This runs one local command. It is free and you can undo it:
behaviour.undoWhere: The undo is on the same card.
behaviour.historyNote: Every change, newest first, with the command that undoes it.
behaviour.rhythm.whenNote: runs by weekday and hour, local time
behaviour.rhythm.qprLabel: questions per run, {from} to {to} over {n} weeks
behaviour.rhythm.qprNote: Each habit you accept and each ledger answer removes a question. The goal is fewer questions, never fewer checks.
behaviour.rhythm.howLabel: answers per week for {n} weeks, by how each was given
behaviour.g.title: Gotchas
behaviour.g.noneHint: A repair loop that goes red to green writes the first one.
behaviour.g.statusNote: A candidate is seen but not proven. It needs 3 cases in 2 or more PRs, or your yes. Quiet means no case in 90 days. Orphaned means its scope matches no file now. Only a person deletes a gotcha.
behaviour.g.listNote: the CLI sends them in its own order
behaviour.g.previewHint: Type the changed paths, separated by commas. This shows the exact card the reviewer gets.
behaviour.g.previewEmpty: Type a path to see the card.
behaviour.g.noCard: No gotcha matches these paths ({n} known). The reviewer gets no gotcha card.
behaviour.q.projectReviews: Project reviews: {n} (counted apart from ORC reviews)
behaviour.q.none: No reviews in this window yet.
behaviour.q.p3Label: advice-only findings over the last {n} reviews
behaviour.q.p3Note: A kind below the target gets fewer advice-only lines. It never gets fewer P0 or P1 checks.
behaviour.q.noSups: No suppression waits for your decision.
behaviour.q.acceptWhat: The reviewer does not raise this advice here again. P0 and P1 findings are never suppressed.
behaviour.q.fixesNone: No fix was recorded in this window. Record one with /orc-fix.
behaviour.q.fixesNote: A fix is never counted as a review. Its author is who found the problem.
behaviour.q.missesNone: No fix touched lines that an earlier review read.
behaviour.log.title: Recent answers
behaviour.log.from: from the ASK lines in your traces
behaviour.log.note: learned means a habit you accepted chose the recommendation. The question was still shown.
behaviour.offCosts: Off costs zero tokens. To start learning, run:
behaviour.railDot: a habit waits for your decision
